claims.if_not_supported: Report regression, control overlap or invalid admission as observed.

negative.not_applicable_reason: This measures implementation cost on identical public instances and asserts no detection or null-population claim; IC and rho A/A arms are the cost null controls.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Every row is a planted known-answer instance independently verified by the existing native harness; native E2E fixtures also exercise verified recovery through the same public recipe.

decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Candidate/baseline cold native ratio; report per-workload rows and reusable setup separately.
decision_rule.interval: Native ecbench v2 linearised 95-percent total-wall interval and paired bootstrap supplement (4000 resamples, seed 20261030).
decision_rule.statistic: Native ecbench total-wall ratio of sums over matched workload/round pairs; counted S and strong-rho distance separately.
decision_rule.text: Report native total-wall candidate/baseline ratio, the native linearised 95-percent interval and bootstrap supplement, IC and rho A/A results, complete pair counts and all failures. C2 is supported only if admitted native total-wall interval lies below one, the shift exceeds IC A/A spread, every scalar and base hash verifies, and no held-out workload reverses the claimed ordering beyond the same control spread. Otherwise report overlap, regression, invalid admission or inconclusive as observed. Do not infer default-path regression against the saved unmodified binary.
decision_rule.threshold: Admitted cold ratio interval entirely below 1 and beyond IC A/A; correctness and holdout conditions all pass.

hypotheses.mechanism: Curve-local byte tables replace dependent squarings; cold table construction is included.

predictions.minimum_effect: Native admitted total-wall interval below one and beyond IC A/A spread.

hypotheses.statement: A cached linear halftrace reduces repeated lifting work while preserving output order.

inadmissible: Local native timing as substitute for required EKS admission
Changing frozen workloads or recipe after seeing data
Default-path no-regression or unmodified-source speedup claims from same-binary controls
m=83, ECC2K-130 or asymptotic transfer claims
Marking a planned or submitted run complete without receipts and replay
invalidation_rules: Any failed scalar replay or unequal baseline/candidate factor-base point hash invalidates C2.
Retain all timeouts, failures, interrupted rows and exclusions; do not select only fast successes.
L2, native A/A admission and complete matched pairs are mandatory for a native-time claim.
A stage-only gain, correctness elapsed time or unchanged coarse operation counter is not an end-to-end result.

links.note: Prospective record before scientific data. Existing PROTOCOL.md and spec inputs are unchanged. Later main has an independently recorded build failure; measurements are scoped to this tested source.

measurement.timed_primary_justification: This is a native engineering cache. Existing coarse as_solves counts do not price its squaring/table delta. Only admitted L2 native complete-pipeline time against A/A can decide C2; counted S is secondary and no algebraic improvement is inferred.

primary.definition: Existing ic.pipeline solve interval includes cold factor-base and cache construction, relation collection, matrix solving and verified recovery. Retain process wall separately; stage times alone cannot establish improvement.

question: On the frozen eight degree-31 K_0 one-target workloads, what is the native cold complete-pipeline cost of cached halftrace lifting versus the preserved legacy lift in the same executable, including table construction?

blinding.how: Unmasked engineering flag comparison. Analysis commands and decision rule are frozen prospectively; no parameter tuning after data.

instance_sampling.rule: Eight uniform-scalar one-target workloads from target_seed=20261030, fixed before data.

seed_derivation.note: Existing ecbench law from measurement.seed=20261030 and frozen plan; retain all row algorithm_seed values.

graphs: Cold total wall by arm and workload with A/A

power.note: Eight independent workload clusters with six paired rounds; same native linearised interval and bootstrap supplement. This is not a prospective guarantee of power for a small effect. A/A overlap or an imprecise interval is inconclusive. The four held-out workloads are reported separately without retuning.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Unmeasured: no authorized isolated preflight has run. Do not substitute correctness-test times. The first admitted call per arm supplies a diagnostic only; it does not alter the fixed budget, sample size or stopping rules.

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed 5 arms x 8 workloads x (1 warmup plus 6 measured rounds) = 280 planned executions; keep the original 900-second Kubernetes deadline including provisioning.
Stop scientific launch if S3 resume checkpoint or source-image identity is not admitted. No automatic measurement retries or input retuning after any observed data.
